items.title: Stellar's Bell Upgrade Goes Live on Testnet Ahead of Mainnet Vote
items.summary: Wallets and indexers must update their software, while smart contracts gain optional post-quantum signature verification.

items.title: CFTC Lets Traders Bet on Stocks With Crypto-Style Perpetual Futures
items.summary: Chairman Michael Selig said “equity perpetual futures” can now trade on CFTC-registered exchanges, extending a crypto-native instrument to traditional stocks.

items.title: Prediction markets bet on Democratic sweep of House, Senate in midterm elections
items.summary: Ahead of polls closing across the U.S., bettors on prediction markes are increasingly pricing in Democrats taking both the House and Senate.

items.title: Justin Sun seeks sanctions against Trump-linked World Liberty Financial over UAE ties
items.summary: The Tron founder says World Liberty failed to disclose its UAE ties until months into his lawsuit over $45 million in WLFI tokens.
